name: Kurama Uika
source: The manifestation of the 'Kurama Tengu', a young woman with a somewhat rough way of speaking who hides a good and generous heart. In addition to working at the local convenience store, she also looks after Susanoo at the local shrine, as well as doing many other small jobs.
